trigger: User screenshot showed Continuous Run Owner loading... and Bank Delete Tools, but no Run State Summary / ZIP / Staging / Registry content in the slot.

diagnosis.problem: Continuous Run Owner detection was reading the first Bank h1/h2 instead of the actual data-bank-detail-title, so it saw Bank instead of Continuous Run Bank and did not fill the owner slot.
visible_evidence: Bank Owner slot existed and showed Continuous Run Owner loading...
Bank Delete Tools showed below the slot.
Continuous Run Owner content did not appear.

what_changed: Continuous Run Owner now checks data-bank-detail-title first, not the first Bank h1/h2.
Continuous Run Owner fills only the Bank Owner provided data-continuous-run-owner-slot-v1 / data-run-bank-tools slot.
The pending message Continuous Run Owner loading... is removed when the owner content fills the slot.
Bank Delete Tools with data-bank-scope=continuous_run are moved into the Continuous Run owner slot and duplicates are removed.
Continuous Run Level UI Scope is called after the owner slot is filled so levels can stack in the correct place.
expected_visual_result_after_refresh: Continuous Run Owner loading... should disappear.
Run State Summary should appear inside Continuous Run Bank.
Lossless Slots ZIP Import should appear.
Bank Delete Tools should be inside the Continuous Run owner slot rather than floating outside the owner stack.
